_doc: Hero battle orders (CombatSimulator, Hero.orders, GameSession.set_hero_orders). A hero gives one stance and one focus; an option opens at min_level, and every level of the Tactics skill lowers that by tactics_skill_discount. The defaults (balanced, any) have no effects, so a battle under them is exactly the standing combat model. Effect keys (summed over stance and focus): attack, initiative (every stack); front_defense (infantry and heavy stacks); advance (melee reaches the enemy this many rounds sooner, negative = later, never before round 1); screen (enemy cavalry and flyers are this much less likely to slip past the line, negative = more); bypass (own cavalry and flyers this much more likely to slip past); back_target_weight (own shots and slipping flankers weigh enemy ranged and support targets by this); guard_weight (own cavalry and flyers weigh enemies that attack own ranged or support stacks by this); strongest_weight / weakest_weight (every stack weighs the most dangerous / most wounded enemy in reach by this). Since save version 22 a hero also gives a formation, an art timing and a standing retreat order (same shape; kinds formation, art, retreat). Formations may list 'classes' (hero classes that know it by heart: open from level 1 and drilled) and a 'skill' (each level of it lowers min_level like Tactics and drills it). A drilled formation's positive effects grow by drill_pct (formation_drill: class_pct, per_skill_level_pct; a hero specialty may add bonus_pct). Extra effect keys: charge_pct (a stack's first melee blow deals this much more), shot_cover (own ranged and support stacks take this much less damage from shots), volley_pct (own opening volley this much stronger), enemy_delay (enemy melee reaches the line this many rounds later), flank_pct (blows on enemies held by the own line deal this much more), reserve_round (the strongest melee stack waits out of reach until this round, unless it is the last one standing), reserve_attack / reserve_morale (the reserve's bonus when it enters), art_round (the hero's art waits until this round), art_loss (the art waits until the army has lost this share of its hit points), art_power (a held art is this much stronger), withdraw_at (the army falls back once its hit points drop to this share; the hero escapes with the survivors), rear_guard (share of every surviving stack lost covering the retreat).

balanced.name: Balanced
balanced.desc: The army fights as it is drilled.

defensive.name: Hold the line
defensive.desc: The line stands its ground: +2 defense for infantry and heavy troops, enemy flankers are 15% less likely to slip past, but your melee advances a round later.

aggressive.name: All-out attack
aggressive.desc: Everyone charges: +1 attack and +1 initiative and melee advances a round sooner, but infantry and heavy troops have -2 defense and enemy flankers slip past 10% more often.

any.name: Free fighting
any.desc: Each stack picks its own targets.

hunt_archers.name: Hunt the archers
hunt_archers.desc: Cavalry and flyers are 25% more likely to slip past the enemy line, and shots and flankers go for enemy archers and supporters first.

protect_archers.name: Guard the archers
protect_archers.desc: Cavalry and flyers ride to the rescue of your archers and supporters, and enemy flankers are 20% less likely to slip past.

strongest.name: Strike the strongest
strongest.desc: The whole army concentrates on the most dangerous enemy stack in reach.

wounded.name: Finish the wounded
wounded.desc: The whole army closes on the most battered enemy stack in reach to break it.

line.name: Battle line
line.desc: The army deploys as drilled: the front line in the middle, flankers on the wings, archers at the back.

shield_wall.name: Shield wall
shield_wall.desc: The front locks shields in one tight wall with the archers right behind it: +3 defense for infantry and heavy troops, archers and supporters take 25% less damage from shots, enemy flankers are 20% less likely to slip past, but the wall advances a round later.

wedge.name: Spearhead wedge
wedge.desc: The army forms an arrowhead and drives into the enemy: melee reaches the line a round sooner, every stack's first melee blow deals 30% more, flankers slip past 10% more often, but the thin sides give -1 defense to the front.

skirmish_screen.name: Skirmish screen
skirmish_screen.desc: Archers deploy in front of the line and fall back behind it when the enemy closes: the opening volley hits 50% harder and enemy melee reaches the line a round later, but enemy flankers slip past 15% more often.

crescent.name: Crescent
crescent.desc: The wings sweep forward around a held centre: blows on enemies already held by your line deal 25% more and your flankers slip past 15% more often, but the thinned centre has -1 defense.

reserve.name: Held reserve
reserve.desc: Your strongest melee battalion waits behind the lines, out of reach, and enters fresh in round 3 with +2 attack and +2 morale (at once if it is the last one standing).

at_once.name: At once
at_once.desc: The hero uses the battle art from the first round.

at_clash.name: When the lines meet
at_clash.desc: The hero prepares the art and looses it from round 2, when the lines meet: 25% stronger.

in_need.name: When the line bends
in_need.desc: The hero holds the art until the army has lost 30% of its strength, then looses it 50% stronger (unused if the army never bends).

never.name: Fight to the last
never.desc: The army never falls back. If it is destroyed, the hero falls.

at_half.name: Fall back at half strength
at_half.desc: Once the army is down to half its strength the hero sounds the retreat: the battle is lost, the rear guard (20% of every surviving stack) is cut down, but the hero escapes with the rest. A hero defending a town never falls back.

when_broken.name: Fall back when broken
when_broken.desc: The army fights on until it is down to a quarter of its strength, then the hero escapes with the survivors (the rear guard, 25% of every stack, is cut down). A hero defending a town never falls back.
